lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's seventy-six? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 76? Nope!

lines.text: Nine dots in a square grid. How many different circles pass through at least three of them?
lines.caption: 9 dots in a square grid. How many different circles pass through at least 3 of them?

lines.text: A circle through four dots still counts once!
lines.caption: A circle through 4 dots still counts once!

lines.text: We get seventy-six groups of three, not on one line. But look at this square.
lines.caption: We get 76 groups of 3, not on one line. But look at this square.

lines.text: Leave out any corner. The other three make the SAME circle!
lines.caption: Leave out any corner. The other 3 make the SAME circle!

lines.text: So that circle got counted four times. Fourteen circles are like that.
lines.caption: So that circle got counted 4 times. 14 circles are like that.

lines.text: Fourteen times three is forty-two extra copies.
lines.caption: 14 times 3 is 42 extra copies.

lines.text: Did you get thirty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 34? Tell me below!
